subject: Banking evidence + CCD remittance sample for vendor onboarding (Fenwick Health)
messages:
From: Rina Kapoor <rina@fenwickhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@fenwickhealth.com
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor bank letter + CCD sample (Fenwick Health -> Redwood)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intake yesterday. Attached is our bank letter signed by Treasury (Fenwick_Bank_Letter_FH-1221.pdf) and a short CCD remittance sample (fenwick_ccd_example.txt) showing the format of our payment reference fields. A few notes: 

- Fenwick will send ACH CCD entries for standard invoices; we can also do wires on request.
- The CCD sample includes our preferred reference format: PO# then invoice number (e.g. PO: 4521-1234 | INV: FH-9988).
- Please confirm whether Redwood requires micro-deposits for ACH validation or if a test wire is preferred.

We also included accounts-payable on the CC in case they need to provide any compliance paperwork. Let me know if the bank letter covers what your finance team needs or if you need any additional evidence (bank contact, routing confirmation).

Best,
Rina Kapoor
Director, Treasury Operations
Fenwick Health
attachments: Fenwick_Bank_Letter_FH-1221.pdf (pdf, 312KB); fenwick_ccd_example.txt (text)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rina Kapoor <rina@fenwickhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor bank letter + CCD sample (Fenwick Health -> Redwood)

Rina — thanks, got both attachments. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Bank letter looks good; we'll upload to vendor record.
- We can accept CCD ACH with the PO+INV reference. That will map to our AP reconciliation field.

Two asks to finish onboarding: 
1) Can you confirm the vendor's legal name and EIN exactly as on the W-9? We need the W-9 to complete the vendor file.
2) Our pay ops team prefers a small test: either micro-deposits (two small ACH amounts) or a $1.00 test wire with "TEST-REDWOOD-FH" in the remittance. Which works for you?

Marissa — looping you in for PO mapping. Please attach the CSV mapping template if you want them to fill it out.

Connor O'Brien
Program Manager, Procure-to-Pay
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rina Kapoor <rina@fenwickhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor bank letter + CCD sample (Fenwick Health -> Redwood) — PO mapping and test schedule

Hi Rina, Connor — thanks for the docs. I created the vendor record in our AP system (Vendor ID: V-298700) and attached a short PO mapping template (po_mapping_template.csv) — please fill the example row so our ledger team can map incoming references to PO fields automatically.

On the test: Fenwick can choose either micro-deposit (two deposits under $0.99) for ACH or a $1.00 USD test wire. If you prefer a test wire, please include "TEST-REDWOOD-FH" in the remittance reference and send it to the bank details in the attached bank letter.

Planned timeline: 
- If you send micro-deposits: we will verify them and confirm by end of day Thursday (2027-11-11).
- If you send a test wire: please aim to send it before 10:00 PST on Wednesday (2027-11-10) so our bank can capture and return the sample receipt. 

Also attaching a short onboarding checklist for finance items we still need (W-9, vendor contact, invoice email).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: po_mapping_template.csv (csv); onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rina Kapoor <rina@fenwickhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor bank letter + CCD sample (Fenwick Health -> Redwood) — Test wire received

Team, 

Quick update from Payments: Banknorth confirmed receipt of the $1.00 test wire this morning; I have the electronic remittance receipt attached (test_wire_receipt_20271110.png). Fields inspected: 
- Amount: $1.00 USD
- Reference: TEST-REDWOOD-FH (matches requested string)
- Originating FI: Fenwick Health / Bank of Fenwick

I also validated the CCD reference format from the fenwick_ccd_example.txt against our PO mapping template. With the CSV mapping Marissa asked for filled in (one example row), our automated matcher will pick up PO# then invoice number into the AP invoice header — test passed.

Next steps for Rina: please upload the completed po_mapping_template.csv and the company W-9 to the secure vendor portal (link below) so we can move to live payments. Once those are in, we'll mark Vendor V-298700 as "payment-ready."

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Payments Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
